description: Single-fault negative vectors. Every vector MUST be rejected with expected_error_class. Mutations of signed fields that keep the object structurally valid MUST fail as invalid_signature; mutations that break structure, key-ID derivation, or caller-authenticated state fail with the structural class. Precedence: strict decode and field format (malformed) before key-ID derivation (key_id_mismatch) before delegation digest, duplicate CertificateRef and chain linkage before any signature check.

procedure_by_kind.delegation_certificate: strict decode; then verify the issuer signature (code 0x0001) with the certificate's issuer_pub_key
procedure_by_kind.key_rotation_statement: strict decode; then verify against verify.rotation_state at verify.now with verify.future_skew_seconds
procedure_by_kind.proof_bundle: strict decode; then structural checks (key IDs, delegation_digest, duplicate CertificateRef, linkage); then every certificate signature and the challenge signature
procedure_by_kind.receipt_bundle_binding: strict decode of wire_b64 (receipt) and bundle_b64; then compare receipt bundle_hash, verifier_id, agent_id, and issuer_ids with the bundle
procedure_by_kind.revocation_list: strict decode; then verify under code 0x0003 with verify.status_key bound to verify.bound_issuer_id
procedure_by_kind.revocation_push: strict decode; then verify under code 0x0005 with verify.status_key bound to verify.bound_issuer_id
procedure_by_kind.transaction_receipt: strict decode (including party bindings, bundle hashes, bundle signatures, and transaction-derived session contexts); then every party signature (code 0x0007)
procedure_by_kind.verification_receipt: strict decode; then verify against verify.head with verify.verifier_key
procedure_by_kind.witness_entry: strict decode; then verify against verify.head with verify.witness_key
